name: Kolyan Indirovich
title: The Late Burgomaster of Barovia
summary: Ireena and Ismark's father, burgomaster of the village of Barovia for twenty years, dead of a failed heart at his own front door. The Tarokka can name him as the party's ally, if he can be given back his life.

guest_build.note: Placeholder until a later phase writes his return from the dead and gives him a fitting stat block.
